sourceChecks.supports: Current consumer documentation: Portuguese input is not split by variety; output is Portuguese covering non-Brazilian varieties or Portuguese (Brazilian). Not a Portugal-only label.

Developer's iPhone listing names Portuguese and Portuguese (Brazilian), photos, dictation, text-to-speech, free download, in-app purchases, paid feature limits. Marketing accuracy claims not repeated.
Dictation uses device speech recognition; supported languages vary with device. No claim that text variety selection controls audio voice.
iOS source/target selection, Image button under source field, camera roll import. Clarity limits.
Text input, complete-sentence context, Listen playback, Settings > Speech region for accents.
Dictation and Profile > Settings > Speech region; regional choices for some languages. English page initially returned 429, then loaded successfully.
Camera > Gallery, clarity limits, available offline camera language downloads.
Translate App section explicitly lists Portuguese (Brazil); no separate Portuguese (Portugal) there. No inference that Apple cannot understand people in Portugal.
Text or Listen input, Play output, language downloads; no blanket offline image/voice guarantee.
